offering_description.value: AZZ coats steel and aluminum coils for metal producers, service centers and manufacturers. It also hot-dip galvanizes fabricated steel for steel fabricators and industrial customers at its own processing plants.

primary_services.value: coil coating; hot-dip galvanizing; coil slitting; coil embossing

customer_segment.value: B2B: metal producers, metal service centers, equipment manufacturers and steel fabricators

end_markets.value: building and construction; appliances and HVAC; infrastructure; transportation; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: service fees: coating and finishing customer-supplied metal coils and galvanizing fabricated steel parts

value_chain_position.value: service provider: coats customer-supplied steel and aluminum coils and fabricated steel for manufacturers and fabricators; asset operator: runs coil coating lines and galvanizing plants that process metal for industrial customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: coil coating and finishing, hot-dip galvanizing and related metal coatings

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving metal producers, service centers, manufacturers and fabricators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: coating and galvanizing operations subject to environmental permits, waste handling rules and workplace safety standards
